frequency_question: What proportion of geopolitical sanction threats or actions against major foreign commercial banks successfully meet formal statutory and administrative criteria for full implementation within the specified timeframe?
membership_rule: Includes any formal executive branch designation, official Treasury announcement, or asset freeze against a Tier-1 foreign commercial bank for breaching secondary sanctions related to specific sanctioned commodities. Excludes mere warnings, diplomatic demarches, or vague secondary sanctions authorities without active targeting.
